description: Compose after uccl-ht: UCCL-EP high-throughput dispatch and combine configs (num_sms, nvl_chunk, nvl_buffer, rdma_chunk, rdma_buffer) tuned for Chonk (hidden 1792) at EP16 (TP1 x DP16, 4 nodes) and 2,048 tokens per rank per call, FP8 dispatch: 2489 us per dispatch + combine in the UCCL microbenchmark (uccl-ht-retune-pinned-20261110). 2,048 tokens per call is a 2,048-token step, or a 4,096-token step with dual batch overlap.
